ticket.summary: Sewage backing up through bathtub drain with toilet gurgling on kitchen sink use at 9 Delmore St — main line blockage, after-hours dispatch requested; elderly occupant in home needing bathroom access.
mitigation_advice: Stop using all water in the house — no flushing, sinks, laundry or dishwasher [PB-05]
Keep people and pets away from the tub and any standing sewage; do not touch it [PB-05]

quote_lines.description: After-hours emergency dispatch surcharge (repair to be quoted on site)

ticket.customer_message: Got it — 9 Delmore St, +1-555-0102, dispatched. Our on-call plumber is typically on the road within about 30–60 minutes; he'll call this number when he's en route. I've flagged the household need so you're top of the queue. Until he arrives, please keep the toilet unused — flushing will push more sewage up through the tub [PB-05]. If your parent needs a bathroom before then, a neighbor's or nearby facility is the safest bet; the plumber can advise as soon as he's on site.
